reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: District of Columbia
    Focus year: 2021
    Question: Are eviction cases first heard in county court?
*/

/* =========================
   SCENARIO FACTS (QUESTION)
   ========================= */

% The question's jurisdiction and year.
scenario_state(district_of_columbia).
scenario_focus_year(2021).

% The question concerns "eviction cases" (modeled as actions to recover possession).
scenario_case_type(eviction_case).

% The question asks whether the first-hearing court is "county court".
scenario_asked_first_heard_in(county_court).

% Helper predicate that succeeds when the full scenario statement is satisfied.
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(district_of_columbia),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_case_type(eviction_case),
    scenario_asked_first_heard_in(county_court).

/* =========================
   STATUTE TRANSLATION
   ========================= */

% DC Code  42-3210 (2021):
% If a tenant fails/refuses to surrender possession after lease expiration or termination,
% landlord may bring an action of ejectment to recover possession in the Superior Court
% of the District of Columbia.
%
% We encode the core jurisdictional rule (venue/forum) for eviction/ejectment actions.
statute_dc_42_3210_eviction_forum(district_of_columbia, 2021, superior_court_of_district_of_columbia).

/* =========================
   LEGAL REASONING HELPERS
   ========================= */

% Map the scenario's "eviction_case" to the statute's kind of action (ejectment/recover possession).
eviction_case_forum(State, Year, Forum) :-
    statute_dc_42_3210_eviction_forum(State, Year, Forum).

% Define what counts as a "county court" for purposes of the question.
% (In this simplified model, the atom county_court denotes a county-level trial court.)
is_county_court(county_court).

% The question asks whether eviction cases are first heard in county court.
% We treat "first heard in county court" as: the governing statute places the case in a county court.
eviction_cases_first_heard_in_county_court(State, Year) :-
    eviction_case_forum(State, Year, Forum),
    is_county_court(Forum).

/* =========================
   FINAL ANSWER
   ========================= */

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_focus_year(Year),
    eviction_cases_first_heard_in_county_court(State, Year),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

/* =========================
   MAIN ENTRYPOINT
   ========================= */

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Are eviction cases first heard in county court?
